title: A chiral centre: four different groups
caption: Butan-2-ol's second carbon carries H, OH, CH₃ and C₂H₅, four different groups, so the molecule is chiral. Propan-2-ol's central carbon has two identical CH₃ groups and is not.
alt: Butan-2-ol with its chiral carbon shaded, beside propan-2-ol, which has no chiral centre.
description: Butan-2-ol: the carbon bearing OH also carries H, CH₃ and CH₂CH₃, so it is a stereocentre.
Propan-2-ol: the central carbon carries two CH₃ groups, so it is not.
